BETA Close X RS Group plc has purchased 143,341 of its ordinary shares for cancellation between September 1 and September 4, 2026, as part of its £100 million share repurchase program. The average price paid per share during this period was approximately 744.39 pence. Following these transactions, the company's total issued ordinary shares stand at 469,383,040, with no shares held in treasury, resulting in a total of 469,383,040 voting rights. Disclaimer* RS Group PLC 07 September 2026 RS Group plc 7 September 2026 Transaction in Own Shares RS Group plc (the "Company") announces that in the week 1 September 2026 to 4 September 2026, it purchased for cancellation the following number of its ordinary shares of 10 pence each (Ordinary Shares) through Barclays Bank plc, as part of its £100 million share repurchase programme announced on 20 May 2026 (the "Programme"). All Ordinary Shares were purchased from Barclays Bank plc as an "on exchange" transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange.
